sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bolg is a cross reference in this book. The reader should look to Fir Bolg. The Fir Bolg were an Irish race of legend. They were the Nemedians under a new name. They returned to Ireland after years of bondage. The Tuatha De Danann then landed among them. These people were the folk of the goddess Danu. They defeated the Fir Bolg and the rest of the Fomorians. Later the Sons of Moles took the land in turn.

okr.objective: Route the reader from Bolg to the Fir Bolg race.
